# Devil’s advocate? Uncensored Luciferus AI service advertised underground
On August 24, 2026, Counter Threat Unit™ (CTU) researchers observed an Exploit underground forum persona named “Optimus_Prime” advertising an uncensored AI subscription service named Luciferus.

The advertisement lists three tiers available for a monthly subscription price: Inquisitor ($35), Archdeviel [sic] ($55), and Prince of Darkness ($75).

# Unregulated AI Service Available On Criminal Forums
_**![](https://www.cybersecurityintelligence.com/files/upload/htmleditor/create-a-photographic-image-of-a-devil-s_ItgwV6SqV-Kdvxf4DA9Jpw_h-etwnhzSFq-Y3RAA8XjVA_cover_2k.png)The  Counter Threat Unit at [Sophos](https://www.cybersecurityintelligence.com/sophos-271.html) has published original research detailing Luciferus, an uncensored artificial intelligence subscription service being advertised on the Exploit underground forum.**_

_**Rather than developing bespoke criminal tools from scratch, buyers can now subscribe to AI systems specifically stripped of safety guardrails.**_

## **Commercialisation of Criminal AI Tools**
Sophos researchers noted that this **[subscription-based model](https://www.cybersecurityintelligence.com/blog/fbi-issues-a-warning-about-a-powerful-new-phaas-platform--9418.html)** mirrors the "as-a-service" structure already common in the criminal underworld, where tools such as ransomware are rented out to affiliates rather than sold outright.

data.description:
# AI Costs Plummet for New Cybercrime Chatbot Luciferus
Luciferus subscriptions start at $22 a month — roughly 80% below WormGPT’s 2023 advertised monthly price.

A new underground AI chatbot called Luciferus is being advertised for about 80% less than WormGPT’s 2023 monthly price, potentially lowering the cost of malware development, fraud and phishing for less-skilled criminals.

[![Beyond the Break weekly cybersecurity newsletter — Subscribe](https://i0.wp.com/securitypointbreak.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/SPB-Newsletter-Promo.jpg?resize=1024%2C108&ssl=1)](https://securitypointbreak.com/newsletter/)

## Luciferus Enters the Underground AI Market
The forum offer listed Inquisitor, Archdeviel and Prince of Darkness tiers at $35, $55 and $75 a month.

## How Can an AI Service Cost $22 a Month?
Luciferus appears to operate as a hosted subscription versus a downloadable software.

Even its $35 Exploit-forum subscription is about 70% cheaper.
